title: Profile timezone in Profile Switch treatments sent to Nightscout is off-by-one
symptom: Profile Switch treatments created by AndroidAPS have an incorrect timezone in the 'timezone' field of the JSON in 'profileJson'. The timezone appears off-by-one, e.g., getting 'Africa/Cairo' (UTC+3) instead of actual 'Europe/Warsaw' (UTC+2). The treatment's 'created_at' field and graph position are correct.
cause: The issue was caused by outdated timezone data on the phone. The phone's timezone database had an incorrect offset for 'Africa/Cairo' (2 hours instead of 3), and because it was the first matching item in the collection, AAPS selected it incorrectly.
fix: Performing a Google Play security update to update the timezone data on the phone resolved the issue. The user also suggested mapping to 'Etc/GMT*' timezones as a potential improvement, but the immediate fix was the security update.
evidence_quote: The fix was to perform Google Play security update which, for whatever reason, my phone doesn't notify me about...
